observations.method: Field-completeness audit of the richer official USAspending award-search subaward response; all returned rows were checked for non-null identifier and location objects.
observations.uncertainty: The endpoint exposes recipient and performance-location fields but not necessarily the actual manufacturing site, workforce, production, acceptance, delivery, or maintenance location.
observations.subgroup: All returned rows in one bounded weapons-system procurement case.
observations.counterinterpretation: Complete fields in a reporting response can still be administratively assigned or normalized; coverage is not operational validation.

related_sources.claim: The sparse subaward route did not expose UEI or location fields, motivating the richer endpoint test.
DLA CAGE records provide a separate facility and parent hierarchy that is not automatically the USAspending recipient location.
Official API contract documents Sub-Recipient UEI, location, performance place, amount, description, and subaward fields.

boundary: This record closes the subaward-to-UEI and subaward-to-reported-location links for all 74 returned rows. It does not establish actual production location, accepted or delivered quantities, workforce, replaceability, readiness, or geopolitical response.
